component.bounds: Voice integer 0..2; row_remaining byte; named byte/word fields and arrays of fixed lengths; bool and unknown fields rejected.
component.runtimeDependencies: Python copy only; no source file, CPU, events or scheduler
component.arithmetic: Binary word addition modulo 65536; byte countdowns. Steps are unsigned encoded 16-bit additive words. Emit the complete high byte without 12-bit normalization.

frequencyDurations.encoding: Four bytes; arpeggio aliases are outside this component

component.incomingStateLimit: SOUND input, not score or instrument initialization. Binary CPU mode required; helper returns no CPU registers/flags. SB offsets 24/25 excluded because these proved paths do not access them.

lifetime.lifeZero: Immediate return with no state change or stores.
lifetime.releaseNormal: Positive release byte decrements; transition to zero writes control & F6 without updating stored control. Life decrements on later invocations.
lifetime.rowControlled: Control bit 08 compares row_remaining with releaseCountdown; below threshold clears stored control & F6 and release. Nonzero control writes once and continues; zero control falls into the normal life decrement.
lifetime.lifeOneToZero: Emit seven zeros at base+6 through base; return before PWM/pitch and preserve their remaining state.
lifetime.sourceEvidence: Primary SOUND/VC/adsr/cc code, captured ending PCs and isolated original-body cases.

pwm.twoPhases: The first nonzero remaining phase adds its word and decrements its counter. Expired phases advance without a blank invocation.
pwm.delay: Positive delay decrements and suppresses pulse stores for that invocation.
pwm.reload: When both counters are zero, bit 7 resets width plus both counters; otherwise bit 0 reloads counters only. No repeat bits means unchanged width is emitted. Reload and first step occur in the same invocation.
pwm.writes: Pulse low then complete high byte, before frequency stores.

pitch.sequence: First live counter among three/four phases decrements and adds its word. Exhaustion reloads all four template counters and steps in the same invocation.
pitch.delay: Positive delay decrements; flag bit 02 selects the fourth word during delay, otherwise no frequency stores.
pitch.writes: Frequency low then high, after lifetime/control and PWM.
pitch.unsupported: Arpeggio flag bit 08 on physical voices 1/3; all-zero repeating templates are rejected as non-terminating. No onset/filter/initializer model.

causalInterventions: Force life=1: terminal clear now, suppressing both programs without advancing their state.
Disable PWM: pulse stores and steps cease while lifetime and sequential pitch advance.
Counter-only versus full reset preserves or replaces the accumulated 16-bit width.
untested: Arbitrary byte combinations beyond the 54 named synthetic cases
Audible release/silence or hardware audio equivalence
